sql_text: WITH RECURSIVE network(origin, destination, depth, path) AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, 1, ARRAY[departure_airport::text, arrival_airport::text] FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'MSQ' UNION SELECT n.origin, f.arrival_airport, n.depth + 1, n.path || f.arrival_airport FROM network n JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.departure_airport = n.destination WHERE n.depth < 2 AND NOT f.arrival_airport = ANY(n.path) ) SELECT destination, MIN(depth) AS hops, COUNT(*) AS alternatives FROM network GROUP BY destination ORDER BY hops, alternatives DESC

WITH RECURSIVE network(origin, destination, depth, path) AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, 1, ARRAY[departure_airport::text, arrival_airport::text] FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'MSQ' UNION SELECT n.origin, f.arrival_airport, n.depth + 1, n.path || f.arrival_airport FROM network n JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.departure_airport = n.destination WHERE n.depth < 2 AND NOT f.arrival_airport = ANY(n.path) ) SELECT destination, MIN(depth) AS hops, COUNT(*) AS alternatives FROM network GROUP BY destination ORDER BY hops, alternatives DESC

SELECT s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id) AS operated_flights, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS occupied, COUNT(bp.ticket_no)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id), 0) AS utilization FROM aviation.seats s JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = s.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.flight_id = f.flight_id AND bp.seat_no = s.seat_no WHERE s.aircraft_code = '320' GROUP BY s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions ORDER BY utilization DESC, s.seat_no

SELECT s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id) AS operated_flights, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS occupied, COUNT(bp.ticket_no)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id), 0) AS utilization FROM aviation.seats s JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = s.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.flight_id = f.flight_id AND bp.seat_no = s.seat_no WHERE s.aircraft_code = '320' GROUP BY s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions ORDER BY utilization DESC, s.seat_no

WITH attendance AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.scheduled_departure, CASE WHEN bp.ticket_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_show FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id ), runs AS ( SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN no_show = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY passenger_id ORDER BY scheduled_departure) AS run_id FROM attendance ) SELECT passenger_id, run_id, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_no_shows FROM runs WHERE no_show = 1 GROUP BY passenger_id, run_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY consecutive_no_shows DESC LIMIT 200

WITH attendance AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.scheduled_departure, CASE WHEN bp.ticket_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_show FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id ), runs AS ( SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN no_show = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY passenger_id ORDER BY scheduled_departure) AS run_id FROM attendance ) SELECT passenger_id, run_id, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_no_shows FROM runs WHERE no_show = 1 GROUP BY passenger_id, run_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY consecutive_no_shows DESC LIMIT 200

WITH cohort AS ( SELECT book_ref FROM aviation.bookings WHERE book_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND book_date < DATE '2025-01-01' + INTERVAL '30 days' ), ticketed AS ( SELECT c.book_ref, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS tickets FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = c.book_ref GROUP BY c.book_ref ), segmented AS ( SELECT x.book_ref, x.tickets, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS boarded FROM ticketed x LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = x.book_ref LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id GROUP BY x.book_ref, x.tickets ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS bookings, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tickets > 0) AS with_tickets, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE segments > 0) AS with_segments, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE boarded > 0) AS with_boarding FROM segmented

WITH cohort AS ( SELECT book_ref FROM aviation.bookings WHERE book_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND book_date < DATE '2025-01-01' + INTERVAL '30 days' ), ticketed AS ( SELECT c.book_ref, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS tickets FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = c.book_ref GROUP BY c.book_ref ), segmented AS ( SELECT x.book_ref, x.tickets, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS boarded FROM ticketed x LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = x.book_ref LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id GROUP BY x.book_ref, x.tickets ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS bookings, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tickets > 0) AS with_tickets, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE segments > 0) AS with_segments, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE boarded > 0) AS with_boarding FROM segmented

WITH itinerary AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, f.scheduled_departure, f.scheduled_arrival, LAG(f.scheduled_arrival) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY f.scheduled_departure ) AS previous_arrival FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id ) SELECT * FROM itinerary WHERE scheduled_departure - previous_arrival < INTERVAL '2 hours' ORDER BY scheduled_departure - previous_arrival LIMIT 200

WITH itinerary AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, f.scheduled_departure, f.scheduled_arrival, LAG(f.scheduled_arrival) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY f.scheduled_departure ) AS previous_arrival FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id ) SELECT * FROM itinerary WHERE scheduled_departure - previous_arrival < INTERVAL '2 hours' ORDER BY scheduled_departure - previous_arrival LIMIT 200

WITH hourly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) AS hour_start, COUNT(*) AS departures FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'IST' AND scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-03-14' - INTERVAL '14 days' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-03-14' + INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) ) SELECT hour_start, departures, SUM(departures) OVER (ORDER BY hour_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS seven_hour_pressure, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY departures) AS pressure_percentile FROM hourly ORDER BY seven_hour_pressure DESC LIMIT 100

WITH hourly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) AS hour_start, COUNT(*) AS departures FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'IST' AND scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-03-14' - INTERVAL '14 days' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-03-14' + INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) ) SELECT hour_start, departures, SUM(departures) OVER (ORDER BY hour_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS seven_hour_pressure, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY departures) AS pressure_percentile FROM hourly ORDER BY seven_hour_pressure DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) AS business_capacity, COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) AS business_sold FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.seats s ON s.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code AND s.fare_conditions = 'Business' LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-10-09' AND f.scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-10-09' + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY f.flight_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) < COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) - COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) AS business_capacity, COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) AS business_sold FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.seats s ON s.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code AND s.fare_conditions = 'Business' LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-10-09' AND f.scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-10-09' + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY f.flight_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) < COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) - COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT b.book_ref, b.book_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS passengers, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.bookings b JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aviation.ticket_flights x WHERE x.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY x.ticket_no HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.book_date ORDER BY segments DESC, revenue DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT b.book_ref, b.book_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS passengers, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.bookings b JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aviation.ticket_flights x WHERE x.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY x.ticket_no HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.book_date ORDER BY segments DESC, revenue DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT tf.ticket_no FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Economy' EXCEPT SELECT bp.ticket_no FROM aviation.boarding_passes bp ORDER BY ticket_no LIMIT 500
SELECT tf.ticket_no FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Economy' EXCEPT SELECT bp.ticket_no FROM aviation.boarding_passes bp ORDER BY ticket_no LIMIT 500

SELECT b.book_ref, b.total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0) AS sold_amount, b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0) AS difference FROM aviation.bookings b LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.total_amount HAVING ABS(b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0)) > 1000 ORDER BY ABS(b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0)) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT b.book_ref, b.total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0) AS sold_amount, b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0) AS difference FROM aviation.bookings b LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.total_amount HAVING ABS(b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0)) > 1000 ORDER BY ABS(b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0)) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS flights, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) AS avg_hours FROM aviation.aircrafts a JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = a.aircraft_code GROUP BY a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, a.range_km HAVING AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) * 800 > a.range_km * 1.0 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC

SELECT a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS flights, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) AS avg_hours FROM aviation.aircrafts a JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = a.aircraft_code GROUP BY a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, a.range_km HAVING AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) * 800 > a.range_km * 1.0 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC

WITH capacity AS ( SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code ), loads AS ( SELECT f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(tf.ticket_no)::numeric / c.seats AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights f JOIN capacity c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'VTB' GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, c.seats ) SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arrival_airport ORDER BY load_factor) AS route_percentile FROM loads ORDER BY route_percentile DESC, load_factor DESC LIMIT 200

WITH capacity AS ( SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code ), loads AS ( SELECT f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(tf.ticket_no)::numeric / c.seats AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights f JOIN capacity c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'VTB' GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, c.seats ) SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arrival_airport ORDER BY load_factor) AS route_percentile FROM loads ORDER BY route_percentile DESC, load_factor DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT passenger_id, MIN(passenger_name) AS canonical_name, COUNT(DISTINCT passenger_name) AS name_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) AS bookings FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) >= 3 ORDER BY name_versions DESC, bookings DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT passenger_id, MIN(passenger_name) AS canonical_name, COUNT(DISTINCT passenger_name) AS name_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) AS bookings FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) >= 3 ORDER BY name_versions DESC, bookings DESC LIMIT 200

WITH route_sales AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue, AVG(peer.revenue) AS peer_average FROM route_sales current JOIN route_sales peer ON peer.departure_airport <> current.departure_airport AND peer.arrival_airport = current.arrival_airport WHERE current.departure_airport = 'BQT' GROUP BY current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue ORDER BY current.revenue - AVG(peer.revenue) DESC

WITH route_sales AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue, AVG(peer.revenue) AS peer_average FROM route_sales current JOIN route_sales peer ON peer.departure_airport <> current.departure_airport AND peer.arrival_airport = current.arrival_airport WHERE current.departure_airport = 'BQT' GROUP BY current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue ORDER BY current.revenue - AVG(peer.revenue) DESC

WITH route_counts AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*)::numeric AS flights FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'Scheduled' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport ), shares AS ( SELECT *, flights / SUM(flights) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS share FROM route_counts ) SELECT departure_airport, SUM(share * share) AS hhi, COUNT(*) AS served_destinations FROM shares GROUP BY departure_airport ORDER BY hhi DESC

WITH route_counts AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*)::numeric AS flights FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'Scheduled' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport ), shares AS ( SELECT *, flights / SUM(flights) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS share FROM route_counts ) SELECT departure_airport, SUM(share * share) AS hhi, COUNT(*) AS served_destinations FROM shares GROUP BY departure_airport ORDER BY hhi DESC

WITH passenger_value AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) >= 5 ), scored AS ( SELECT *, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS value_decile FROM passenger_value ) SELECT value_decile, COUNT(*) AS passengers, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM scored GROUP BY value_decile ORDER BY value_decile

WITH passenger_value AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) >= 5 ), scored AS ( SELECT *, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS value_decile FROM passenger_value ) SELECT value_decile, COUNT(*) AS passengers, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM scored GROUP BY value_decile ORDER BY value_decile

WITH monthly_routes AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start, departure_airport ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS position FROM monthly_routes ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE position <= 7 ORDER BY month_start, departure_airport, position

WITH monthly_routes AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start, departure_airport ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS position FROM monthly_routes ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE position <= 7 ORDER BY month_start, departure_airport, position

WITH route_stats AS ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q3 FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Comfort' GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT f.flight_id, tf.ticket_no, tf.amount, s.q1, s.q3 FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id JOIN route_stats s USING (departure_airport, arrival_airport) WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Comfort' AND (tf.amount < s.q1 - 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1) OR tf.amount > s.q3 + 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1)) ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 200

WITH route_stats AS ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q3 FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Comfort' GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT f.flight_id, tf.ticket_no, tf.amount, s.q1, s.q3 FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id JOIN route_stats s USING (departure_airport, arrival_airport) WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Comfort' AND (tf.amount < s.q1 - 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1) OR tf.amount > s.q3 + 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1)) ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT route.departure_airport, route.arrival_airport, expensive.ticket_no, expensive.amount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT departure_airport, arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights) route CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tf.ticket_no, tf.amount FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = route.departure_airport AND f.arrival_airport = route.arrival_airport AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Comfort' ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 3 ) expensive ORDER BY route.departure_airport, route.arrival_airport, expensive.amount DESC

SELECT route.departure_airport, route.arrival_airport, expensive.ticket_no, expensive.amount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT departure_airport, arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights) route CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tf.ticket_no, tf.amount FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = route.departure_airport AND f.arrival_airport = route.arrival_airport AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Comfort' ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 3 ) expensive ORDER BY route.departure_airport, route.arrival_airport, expensive.amount DESC

SELECT r.arrival_airport, p.passenger_id, p.route_revenue FROM (SELECT DISTINCT arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'IST') r CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.passenger_id, SUM(tf.amount) AS route_revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE f.departure_airport = 'IST' AND f.arrival_airport = r.arrival_airport GROUP BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY route_revenue DESC LIMIT 5 ) p ORDER BY r.arrival_airport, p.route_revenue DESC

SELECT r.arrival_airport, p.passenger_id, p.route_revenue FROM (SELECT DISTINCT arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'IST') r CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.passenger_id, SUM(tf.amount) AS route_revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE f.departure_airport = 'IST' AND f.arrival_airport = r.arrival_airport GROUP BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY route_revenue DESC LIMIT 5 ) p ORDER BY r.arrival_airport, p.route_revenue DESC

SELECT passenger_id FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 INTERSECT SELECT t.passenger_id FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY passenger_id LIMIT 500

SELECT passenger_id FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 INTERSECT SELECT t.passenger_id FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY passenger_id LIMIT 500

SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, AVG(tf.amount) AS avg_fare FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport HAVING AVG(tf.amount) > 1.05 * ( SELECT AVG(tf2.amount) FROM aviation.flights f2 JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf2 ON tf2.flight_id = f2.flight_id WHERE f2.departure_airport = f.departure_airport ) ORDER BY avg_fare DESC

SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, AVG(tf.amount) AS avg_fare FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport HAVING AVG(tf.amount) > 1.05 * ( SELECT AVG(tf2.amount) FROM aviation.flights f2 JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf2 ON tf2.flight_id = f2.flight_id WHERE f2.departure_airport = f.departure_airport ) ORDER BY avg_fare DESC

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, tf.fare_conditions, COUNT(*) AS sold FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'BQT' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), tf.fare_conditions ), shares AS ( SELECT *, sold::numeric / SUM(sold) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) AS share FROM monthly ) SELECT *, share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY fare_conditions ORDER BY month_start) AS share_change FROM shares ORDER BY ABS(share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY fare_conditions ORDER BY month_start)) DESC NULLS LAST

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, tf.fare_conditions, COUNT(*) AS sold FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'BQT' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), tf.fare_conditions ), shares AS ( SELECT *, sold::numeric / SUM(sold) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) AS share FROM monthly ) SELECT *, share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY fare_conditions ORDER BY month_start) AS share_change FROM shares ORDER BY ABS(share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY fare_conditions ORDER BY month_start)) DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.passenger_id) t.passenger_id, t.passenger_name, b.book_ref, b.book_date, b.total_amount FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref WHERE t.passenger_id LIKE '83%' ORDER BY t.passenger_id, b.book_date DESC, b.book_ref DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.passenger_id) t.passenger_id, t.passenger_name, b.book_ref, b.book_date, b.total_amount FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref WHERE t.passenger_id LIKE '83%' ORDER BY t.passenger_id, b.book_date DESC, b.book_ref DESC

SELECT 'tickets_without_booking' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM aviation.tickets t LEFT JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref WHERE b.book_ref IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'segments_without_ticket', COUNT(*) FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE t.ticket_no IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'boarding_without_segment', COUNT(*) FROM aviation.boarding_passes bp LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = bp.ticket_no AND tf.flight_id = bp.flight_id WHERE tf.ticket_no IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'flight_without_aircraft', COUNT(*) FROM aviation.flights f LEFT JOIN aviation.aircrafts a ON a.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code WHERE a.aircraft_code IS NULL AND f.flight_id >= 14001

SELECT 'tickets_without_booking' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM aviation.tickets t LEFT JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref WHERE b.book_ref IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'segments_without_ticket', COUNT(*) FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE t.ticket_no IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'boarding_without_segment', COUNT(*) FROM aviation.boarding_passes bp LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = bp.ticket_no AND tf.flight_id = bp.flight_id WHERE tf.ticket_no IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'flight_without_aircraft', COUNT(*) FROM aviation.flights f LEFT JOIN aviation.aircrafts a ON a.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code WHERE a.aircraft_code IS NULL AND f.flight_id >= 14001

WITH route_stats AS ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q3 FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT f.flight_id, tf.ticket_no, tf.amount, s.q1, s.q3 FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id JOIN route_stats s USING (departure_airport, arrival_airport) WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' AND (tf.amount < s.q1 - 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1) OR tf.amount > s.q3 + 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1)) ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 200

WITH route_stats AS ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q3 FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT f.flight_id, tf.ticket_no, tf.amount, s.q1, s.q3 FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id JOIN route_stats s USING (departure_airport, arrival_airport) WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' AND (tf.amount < s.q1 - 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1) OR tf.amount > s.q3 + 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1)) ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 200

WITH route_sales AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue, AVG(peer.revenue) AS peer_average FROM route_sales current JOIN route_sales peer ON peer.departure_airport <> current.departure_airport AND peer.arrival_airport = current.arrival_airport WHERE current.departure_airport = 'LED' GROUP BY current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue ORDER BY current.revenue - AVG(peer.revenue) DESC

WITH route_sales AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue, AVG(peer.revenue) AS peer_average FROM route_sales current JOIN route_sales peer ON peer.departure_airport <> current.departure_airport AND peer.arrival_airport = current.arrival_airport WHERE current.departure_airport = 'LED' GROUP BY current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue ORDER BY current.revenue - AVG(peer.revenue) DESC

SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, AVG(tf.amount) AS avg_fare FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport HAVING AVG(tf.amount) > 1.1 * ( SELECT AVG(tf2.amount) FROM aviation.flights f2 JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf2 ON tf2.flight_id = f2.flight_id WHERE f2.departure_airport = f.departure_airport ) ORDER BY avg_fare DESC

SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, AVG(tf.amount) AS avg_fare FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport HAVING AVG(tf.amount) > 1.1 * ( SELECT AVG(tf2.amount) FROM aviation.flights f2 JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf2 ON tf2.flight_id = f2.flight_id WHERE f2.departure_airport = f.departure_airport ) ORDER BY avg_fare DESC

WITH daily AS ( SELECT book_date::date AS day, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS bookings FROM aviation.bookings GROUP BY book_date::date ) SELECT day, revenue, bookings, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue, AVG(bookings) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_bookings FROM daily ORDER BY day

WITH daily AS ( SELECT book_date::date AS day, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS bookings FROM aviation.bookings GROUP BY book_date::date ) SELECT day, revenue, bookings, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue, AVG(bookings) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_bookings FROM daily ORDER BY day

WITH monthly_routes AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start, departure_airport ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS position FROM monthly_routes ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE position <= 7 ORDER BY month_start, departure_airport, position

WITH monthly_routes AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start, departure_airport ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS position FROM monthly_routes ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE position <= 7 ORDER BY month_start, departure_airport, position

SELECT r.arrival_airport, p.passenger_id, p.route_revenue FROM (SELECT DISTINCT arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'WAW') r CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.passenger_id, SUM(tf.amount) AS route_revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE f.departure_airport = 'WAW' AND f.arrival_airport = r.arrival_airport GROUP BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY route_revenue DESC LIMIT 5 ) p ORDER BY r.arrival_airport, p.route_revenue DESC

SELECT r.arrival_airport, p.passenger_id, p.route_revenue FROM (SELECT DISTINCT arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'WAW') r CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.passenger_id, SUM(tf.amount) AS route_revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE f.departure_airport = 'WAW' AND f.arrival_airport = r.arrival_airport GROUP BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY route_revenue DESC LIMIT 5 ) p ORDER BY r.arrival_airport, p.route_revenue DESC

WITH attendance AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.scheduled_departure, CASE WHEN bp.ticket_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_show FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id ), runs AS ( SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN no_show = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY passenger_id ORDER BY scheduled_departure) AS run_id FROM attendance ) SELECT passenger_id, run_id, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_no_shows FROM runs WHERE no_show = 1 GROUP BY passenger_id, run_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY consecutive_no_shows DESC LIMIT 200

WITH attendance AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.scheduled_departure, CASE WHEN bp.ticket_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_show FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id ), runs AS ( SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN no_show = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY passenger_id ORDER BY scheduled_departure) AS run_id FROM attendance ) SELECT passenger_id, run_id, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_no_shows FROM runs WHERE no_show = 1 GROUP BY passenger_id, run_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY consecutive_no_shows DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id) AS operated_flights, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS occupied, COUNT(bp.ticket_no)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id), 0) AS utilization FROM aviation.seats s JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = s.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.flight_id = f.flight_id AND bp.seat_no = s.seat_no WHERE s.aircraft_code = '320' GROUP BY s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions ORDER BY utilization DESC, s.seat_no

SELECT s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id) AS operated_flights, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS occupied, COUNT(bp.ticket_no)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id), 0) AS utilization FROM aviation.seats s JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = s.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.flight_id = f.flight_id AND bp.seat_no = s.seat_no WHERE s.aircraft_code = '320' GROUP BY s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions ORDER BY utilization DESC, s.seat_no

WITH itinerary AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, f.scheduled_departure, f.scheduled_arrival, LAG(f.scheduled_arrival) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY f.scheduled_departure ) AS previous_arrival FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id ) SELECT * FROM itinerary WHERE scheduled_departure - previous_arrival < INTERVAL '2 hours' ORDER BY scheduled_departure - previous_arrival LIMIT 200

WITH itinerary AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, f.scheduled_departure, f.scheduled_arrival, LAG(f.scheduled_arrival) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY f.scheduled_departure ) AS previous_arrival FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id ) SELECT * FROM itinerary WHERE scheduled_departure - previous_arrival < INTERVAL '2 hours' ORDER BY scheduled_departure - previous_arrival LIMIT 200

WITH RECURSIVE network(origin, destination, depth, path) AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, 1, ARRAY[departure_airport::text, arrival_airport::text] FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'WAW' UNION SELECT n.origin, f.arrival_airport, n.depth + 1, n.path || f.arrival_airport FROM network n JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.departure_airport = n.destination WHERE n.depth < 2 AND NOT f.arrival_airport = ANY(n.path) ) SELECT destination, MIN(depth) AS hops, COUNT(*) AS alternatives FROM network GROUP BY destination ORDER BY hops, alternatives DESC

WITH RECURSIVE network(origin, destination, depth, path) AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, 1, ARRAY[departure_airport::text, arrival_airport::text] FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'WAW' UNION SELECT n.origin, f.arrival_airport, n.depth + 1, n.path || f.arrival_airport FROM network n JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.departure_airport = n.destination WHERE n.depth < 2 AND NOT f.arrival_airport = ANY(n.path) ) SELECT destination, MIN(depth) AS hops, COUNT(*) AS alternatives FROM network GROUP BY destination ORDER BY hops, alternatives DESC

WITH first_booking AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, MIN(date_trunc('month', b.book_date)) AS cohort_month FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref GROUP BY t.passenger_id ), activity AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.passenger_id, date_trunc('month', b.book_date) AS activity_month FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' ) SELECT f.cohort_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(a.activity_month, f.cohort_month)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(a.activity_month, f.cohort_month)) AS month_number, COUNT(DISTINCT a.passenger_id) AS retained_passengers FROM first_booking f JOIN activity a ON a.passenger_id = f.passenger_id GROUP BY f.cohort_month, month_number ORDER BY f.cohort_month, month_number

WITH first_booking AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, MIN(date_trunc('month', b.book_date)) AS cohort_month FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref GROUP BY t.passenger_id ), activity AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.passenger_id, date_trunc('month', b.book_date) AS activity_month FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' ) SELECT f.cohort_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(a.activity_month, f.cohort_month)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(a.activity_month, f.cohort_month)) AS month_number, COUNT(DISTINCT a.passenger_id) AS retained_passengers FROM first_booking f JOIN activity a ON a.passenger_id = f.passenger_id GROUP BY f.cohort_month, month_number ORDER BY f.cohort_month, month_number

SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) AS business_capacity, COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) AS business_sold FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.seats s ON s.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code AND s.fare_conditions = 'Business' LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-01-02' AND f.scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-01-02' + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY f.flight_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) < COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) - COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) AS business_capacity, COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) AS business_sold FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.seats s ON s.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code AND s.fare_conditions = 'Business' LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' WHERE f.scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-01-02' AND f.scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-01-02' + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY f.flight_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) < COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.seat_no) - COUNT(DISTINCT tf.ticket_no) DESC LIMIT 200

WITH hourly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) AS hour_start, COUNT(*) AS departures FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'BQT' AND scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-06-21' - INTERVAL '14 days' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-06-21' + INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) ) SELECT hour_start, departures, SUM(departures) OVER (ORDER BY hour_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS seven_hour_pressure, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY departures) AS pressure_percentile FROM hourly ORDER BY seven_hour_pressure DESC LIMIT 100

WITH hourly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) AS hour_start, COUNT(*) AS departures FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'BQT' AND scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-06-21' - INTERVAL '14 days' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-06-21' + INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) ) SELECT hour_start, departures, SUM(departures) OVER (ORDER BY hour_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS seven_hour_pressure, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY departures) AS pressure_percentile FROM hourly ORDER BY seven_hour_pressure DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, status, aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS flights, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (scheduled_arrival - scheduled_departure)) / 60) AS avg_minutes FROM aviation.flights WHERE scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-10-23' - INTERVAL '60 days' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-10-23' + INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY CUBE (departure_airport, arrival_airport, status, aircraft_code) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY flights DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500

SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, status, aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS flights, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (scheduled_arrival - scheduled_departure)) / 60) AS avg_minutes FROM aviation.flights WHERE scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-10-23' - INTERVAL '60 days' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-10-23' + INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY CUBE (departure_airport, arrival_airport, status, aircraft_code) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY flights DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500

SELECT a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS flights, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) AS avg_hours FROM aviation.aircrafts a JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = a.aircraft_code GROUP BY a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, a.range_km HAVING AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) * 800 > a.range_km * 0.7 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC

SELECT a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS flights, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) AS avg_hours FROM aviation.aircrafts a JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = a.aircraft_code GROUP BY a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, a.range_km HAVING AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) * 800 > a.range_km * 0.7 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC

SELECT passenger_id, MIN(passenger_name) AS canonical_name, COUNT(DISTINCT passenger_name) AS name_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) AS bookings FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) >= 4 ORDER BY name_versions DESC, bookings DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT passenger_id, MIN(passenger_name) AS canonical_name, COUNT(DISTINCT passenger_name) AS name_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) AS bookings FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) >= 4 ORDER BY name_versions DESC, bookings DESC LIMIT 200

WITH capacity AS ( SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code ), loads AS ( SELECT f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(tf.ticket_no)::numeric / c.seats AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights f JOIN capacity c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'VTB' GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, c.seats ) SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arrival_airport ORDER BY load_factor) AS route_percentile FROM loads ORDER BY route_percentile DESC, load_factor DESC LIMIT 200

WITH capacity AS ( SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code ), loads AS ( SELECT f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(tf.ticket_no)::numeric / c.seats AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights f JOIN capacity c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'VTB' GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, c.seats ) SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arrival_airport ORDER BY load_factor) AS route_percentile FROM loads ORDER BY route_percentile DESC, load_factor DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT route.departure_airport, route.arrival_airport, expensive.ticket_no, expensive.amount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT departure_airport, arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights) route CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tf.ticket_no, tf.amount FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = route.departure_airport AND f.arrival_airport = route.arrival_airport AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 3 ) expensive ORDER BY route.departure_airport, route.arrival_airport, expensive.amount DESC

SELECT route.departure_airport, route.arrival_airport, expensive.ticket_no, expensive.amount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT departure_airport, arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights) route CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tf.ticket_no, tf.amount FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = route.departure_airport AND f.arrival_airport = route.arrival_airport AND tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 3 ) expensive ORDER BY route.departure_airport, route.arrival_airport, expensive.amount DESC

SELECT passenger_id FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 INTERSECT SELECT t.passenger_id FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY passenger_id LIMIT 500

SELECT passenger_id FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 INTERSECT SELECT t.passenger_id FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY passenger_id LIMIT 500

WITH route_counts AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*)::numeric AS flights FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'Arrived' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport ), shares AS ( SELECT *, flights / SUM(flights) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS share FROM route_counts ) SELECT departure_airport, SUM(share * share) AS hhi, COUNT(*) AS served_destinations FROM shares GROUP BY departure_airport ORDER BY hhi DESC

WITH route_counts AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*)::numeric AS flights FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'Arrived' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport ), shares AS ( SELECT *, flights / SUM(flights) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS share FROM route_counts ) SELECT departure_airport, SUM(share * share) AS hhi, COUNT(*) AS served_destinations FROM shares GROUP BY departure_airport ORDER BY hhi DESC

WITH itinerary AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, f.scheduled_departure, f.scheduled_arrival, LAG(f.scheduled_arrival) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY f.scheduled_departure ) AS previous_arrival FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id ) SELECT * FROM itinerary WHERE scheduled_departure - previous_arrival < INTERVAL '4 hours' ORDER BY scheduled_departure - previous_arrival LIMIT 200

WITH itinerary AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, f.scheduled_departure, f.scheduled_arrival, LAG(f.scheduled_arrival) OVER ( PARTITION BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY f.scheduled_departure ) AS previous_arrival FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id ) SELECT * FROM itinerary WHERE scheduled_departure - previous_arrival < INTERVAL '4 hours' ORDER BY scheduled_departure - previous_arrival LIMIT 200

WITH hourly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) AS hour_start, COUNT(*) AS departures FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'TBS' AND scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-08-05' - INTERVAL '14 days' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-08-05' + INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) ) SELECT hour_start, departures, SUM(departures) OVER (ORDER BY hour_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS seven_hour_pressure, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY departures) AS pressure_percentile FROM hourly ORDER BY seven_hour_pressure DESC LIMIT 100

WITH hourly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) AS hour_start, COUNT(*) AS departures FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'TBS' AND scheduled_departure >= DATE '2025-08-05' - INTERVAL '14 days' AND scheduled_departure < DATE '2025-08-05' + INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', scheduled_departure) ) SELECT hour_start, departures, SUM(departures) OVER (ORDER BY hour_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS seven_hour_pressure, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY departures) AS pressure_percentile FROM hourly ORDER BY seven_hour_pressure DESC LIMIT 100

WITH capacity AS ( SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code ), loads AS ( SELECT f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(tf.ticket_no)::numeric / c.seats AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights f JOIN capacity c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'SVO' GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, c.seats ) SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arrival_airport ORDER BY load_factor) AS route_percentile FROM loads ORDER BY route_percentile DESC, load_factor DESC LIMIT 200

WITH capacity AS ( SELECT aircraft_code, COUNT(*) AS seats FROM aviation.seats GROUP BY aircraft_code ), loads AS ( SELECT f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(tf.ticket_no)::numeric / c.seats AS load_factor FROM aviation.flights f JOIN capacity c ON c.aircraft_code = f.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'SVO' GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.arrival_airport, c.seats ) SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arrival_airport ORDER BY load_factor) AS route_percentile FROM loads ORDER BY route_percentile DESC, load_factor DESC LIMIT 200

WITH monthly_routes AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start, departure_airport ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS position FROM monthly_routes ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE position <= 3 ORDER BY month_start, departure_airport, position

WITH monthly_routes AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start, departure_airport ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS position FROM monthly_routes ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE position <= 3 ORDER BY month_start, departure_airport, position

WITH RECURSIVE network(origin, destination, depth, path) AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, 1, ARRAY[departure_airport::text, arrival_airport::text] FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'GME' UNION SELECT n.origin, f.arrival_airport, n.depth + 1, n.path || f.arrival_airport FROM network n JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.departure_airport = n.destination WHERE n.depth < 2 AND NOT f.arrival_airport = ANY(n.path) ) SELECT destination, MIN(depth) AS hops, COUNT(*) AS alternatives FROM network GROUP BY destination ORDER BY hops, alternatives DESC

WITH RECURSIVE network(origin, destination, depth, path) AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, 1, ARRAY[departure_airport::text, arrival_airport::text] FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'GME' UNION SELECT n.origin, f.arrival_airport, n.depth + 1, n.path || f.arrival_airport FROM network n JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.departure_airport = n.destination WHERE n.depth < 2 AND NOT f.arrival_airport = ANY(n.path) ) SELECT destination, MIN(depth) AS hops, COUNT(*) AS alternatives FROM network GROUP BY destination ORDER BY hops, alternatives DESC

SELECT passenger_id, MIN(passenger_name) AS canonical_name, COUNT(DISTINCT passenger_name) AS name_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) AS bookings FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) >= 3 ORDER BY name_versions DESC, bookings DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT passenger_id, MIN(passenger_name) AS canonical_name, COUNT(DISTINCT passenger_name) AS name_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) AS bookings FROM aviation.tickets GROUP BY passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT book_ref) >= 3 ORDER BY name_versions DESC, bookings DESC LIMIT 200

WITH attendance AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.scheduled_departure, CASE WHEN bp.ticket_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_show FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id ), runs AS ( SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN no_show = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY passenger_id ORDER BY scheduled_departure) AS run_id FROM attendance ) SELECT passenger_id, run_id, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_no_shows FROM runs WHERE no_show = 1 GROUP BY passenger_id, run_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY consecutive_no_shows DESC LIMIT 200

WITH attendance AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, f.scheduled_departure, CASE WHEN bp.ticket_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS no_show FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id ), runs AS ( SELECT *, SUM(CASE WHEN no_show = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY passenger_id ORDER BY scheduled_departure) AS run_id FROM attendance ) SELECT passenger_id, run_id, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_no_shows FROM runs WHERE no_show = 1 GROUP BY passenger_id, run_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY consecutive_no_shows DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT b.book_ref, b.total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0) AS sold_amount, b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0) AS difference FROM aviation.bookings b LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.total_amount HAVING ABS(b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0)) > 2500 ORDER BY ABS(b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0)) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT b.book_ref, b.total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0) AS sold_amount, b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0) AS difference FROM aviation.bookings b LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.total_amount HAVING ABS(b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0)) > 2500 ORDER BY ABS(b.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(tf.amount), 0)) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id) AS operated_flights, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS occupied, COUNT(bp.ticket_no)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id), 0) AS utilization FROM aviation.seats s JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = s.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.flight_id = f.flight_id AND bp.seat_no = s.seat_no WHERE s.aircraft_code = '321' GROUP BY s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions ORDER BY utilization DESC, s.seat_no

SELECT s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions, COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id) AS operated_flights, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS occupied, COUNT(bp.ticket_no)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id), 0) AS utilization FROM aviation.seats s JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = s.aircraft_code LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.flight_id = f.flight_id AND bp.seat_no = s.seat_no WHERE s.aircraft_code = '321' GROUP BY s.seat_no, s.fare_conditions ORDER BY utilization DESC, s.seat_no

WITH route_counts AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*)::numeric AS flights FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'Scheduled' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport ), shares AS ( SELECT *, flights / SUM(flights) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS share FROM route_counts ) SELECT departure_airport, SUM(share * share) AS hhi, COUNT(*) AS served_destinations FROM shares GROUP BY departure_airport ORDER BY hhi DESC

WITH route_counts AS ( SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport, COUNT(*)::numeric AS flights FROM aviation.flights WHERE status = 'Scheduled' GROUP BY departure_airport, arrival_airport ), shares AS ( SELECT *, flights / SUM(flights) OVER (PARTITION BY departure_airport) AS share FROM route_counts ) SELECT departure_airport, SUM(share * share) AS hhi, COUNT(*) AS served_destinations FROM shares GROUP BY departure_airport ORDER BY hhi DESC

WITH route_stats AS ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q3 FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Economy' GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT f.flight_id, tf.ticket_no, tf.amount, s.q1, s.q3 FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id JOIN route_stats s USING (departure_airport, arrival_airport) WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Economy' AND (tf.amount < s.q1 - 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1) OR tf.amount > s.q3 + 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1)) ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 200

WITH route_stats AS ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tf.amount) AS q3 FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Economy' GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT f.flight_id, tf.ticket_no, tf.amount, s.q1, s.q3 FROM aviation.ticket_flights tf JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.flight_id = tf.flight_id JOIN route_stats s USING (departure_airport, arrival_airport) WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Economy' AND (tf.amount < s.q1 - 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1) OR tf.amount > s.q3 + 1.5 * (s.q3 - s.q1)) ORDER BY tf.amount DESC LIMIT 200

WITH first_booking AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, MIN(date_trunc('month', b.book_date)) AS cohort_month FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref GROUP BY t.passenger_id ), activity AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.passenger_id, date_trunc('month', b.book_date) AS activity_month FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' ) SELECT f.cohort_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(a.activity_month, f.cohort_month)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(a.activity_month, f.cohort_month)) AS month_number, COUNT(DISTINCT a.passenger_id) AS retained_passengers FROM first_booking f JOIN activity a ON a.passenger_id = f.passenger_id GROUP BY f.cohort_month, month_number ORDER BY f.cohort_month, month_number

WITH first_booking AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, MIN(date_trunc('month', b.book_date)) AS cohort_month FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref GROUP BY t.passenger_id ), activity AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.passenger_id, date_trunc('month', b.book_date) AS activity_month FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.bookings b ON b.book_ref = t.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE tf.fare_conditions = 'Business' ) SELECT f.cohort_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(a.activity_month, f.cohort_month)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(a.activity_month, f.cohort_month)) AS month_number, COUNT(DISTINCT a.passenger_id) AS retained_passengers FROM first_booking f JOIN activity a ON a.passenger_id = f.passenger_id GROUP BY f.cohort_month, month_number ORDER BY f.cohort_month, month_number

SELECT b.book_ref, b.book_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS passengers, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.bookings b JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aviation.ticket_flights x WHERE x.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY x.ticket_no HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ) GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.book_date ORDER BY segments DESC, revenue DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT b.book_ref, b.book_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS passengers, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.bookings b JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = b.book_ref JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aviation.ticket_flights x WHERE x.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY x.ticket_no HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ) GROUP BY b.book_ref, b.book_date ORDER BY segments DESC, revenue DESC LIMIT 200

WITH RECURSIVE calendar(day) AS ( SELECT DATE '2025-06-07' UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM calendar WHERE day < DATE '2025-06-07' + 60 ), traffic AS ( SELECT scheduled_departure::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM aviation.flights GROUP BY scheduled_departure::date ) SELECT c.day, COALESCE(t.flights, 0) AS flights, AVG(COALESCE(t.flights, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY c.day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS weekly_average FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN traffic t USING (day) ORDER BY c.day

WITH RECURSIVE calendar(day) AS ( SELECT DATE '2025-06-07' UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM calendar WHERE day < DATE '2025-06-07' + 60 ), traffic AS ( SELECT scheduled_departure::date AS day, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM aviation.flights GROUP BY scheduled_departure::date ) SELECT c.day, COALESCE(t.flights, 0) AS flights, AVG(COALESCE(t.flights, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY c.day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS weekly_average FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN traffic t USING (day) ORDER BY c.day

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, tf.fare_conditions, COUNT(*) AS sold FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'IST' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), tf.fare_conditions ), shares AS ( SELECT *, sold::numeric / SUM(sold) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) AS share FROM monthly ) SELECT *, share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY fare_conditions ORDER BY month_start) AS share_change FROM shares ORDER BY ABS(share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY fare_conditions ORDER BY month_start)) DESC NULLS LAST

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure) AS month_start, tf.fare_conditions, COUNT(*) AS sold FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.departure_airport = 'IST' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.scheduled_departure), tf.fare_conditions ), shares AS ( SELECT *, sold::numeric / SUM(sold) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) AS share FROM monthly ) SELECT *, share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY fare_conditions ORDER BY month_start) AS share_change FROM shares ORDER BY ABS(share - LAG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY fare_conditions ORDER BY month_start)) DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT r.arrival_airport, p.passenger_id, p.route_revenue FROM (SELECT DISTINCT arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'LED') r CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.passenger_id, SUM(tf.amount) AS route_revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE f.departure_airport = 'LED' AND f.arrival_airport = r.arrival_airport GROUP BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY route_revenue DESC LIMIT 5 ) p ORDER BY r.arrival_airport, p.route_revenue DESC

SELECT r.arrival_airport, p.passenger_id, p.route_revenue FROM (SELECT DISTINCT arrival_airport FROM aviation.flights WHERE departure_airport = 'LED') r CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.passenger_id, SUM(tf.amount) AS route_revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no WHERE f.departure_airport = 'LED' AND f.arrival_airport = r.arrival_airport GROUP BY t.passenger_id ORDER BY route_revenue DESC LIMIT 5 ) p ORDER BY r.arrival_airport, p.route_revenue DESC

WITH route_sales AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue, AVG(peer.revenue) AS peer_average FROM route_sales current JOIN route_sales peer ON peer.departure_airport <> current.departure_airport AND peer.arrival_airport = current.arrival_airport WHERE current.departure_airport = 'GNA' GROUP BY current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue ORDER BY current.revenue - AVG(peer.revenue) DESC

WITH route_sales AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.flights f JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.flight_id = f.flight_id GROUP BY f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport ) SELECT current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue, AVG(peer.revenue) AS peer_average FROM route_sales current JOIN route_sales peer ON peer.departure_airport <> current.departure_airport AND peer.arrival_airport = current.arrival_airport WHERE current.departure_airport = 'GNA' GROUP BY current.arrival_airport, current.tickets, current.revenue ORDER BY current.revenue - AVG(peer.revenue) DESC

WITH daily AS ( SELECT book_date::date AS day, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS bookings FROM aviation.bookings GROUP BY book_date::date ) SELECT day, revenue, bookings, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 55 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue, AVG(bookings) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 55 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_bookings FROM daily ORDER BY day

WITH daily AS ( SELECT book_date::date AS day, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS bookings FROM aviation.bookings GROUP BY book_date::date ) SELECT day, revenue, bookings, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 55 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_revenue, AVG(bookings) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 55 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_bookings FROM daily ORDER BY day

WITH passenger_value AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) >= 5 ), scored AS ( SELECT *, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS value_decile FROM passenger_value ) SELECT value_decile, COUNT(*) AS passengers, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM scored GROUP BY value_decile ORDER BY value_decile

WITH passenger_value AS ( SELECT t.passenger_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS tickets, SUM(tf.amount) AS revenue FROM aviation.tickets t JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no GROUP BY t.passenger_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) >= 5 ), scored AS ( SELECT *, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS value_decile FROM passenger_value ) SELECT value_decile, COUNT(*) AS passengers, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM scored GROUP BY value_decile ORDER BY value_decile

WITH cohort AS ( SELECT book_ref FROM aviation.bookings WHERE book_date >= DATE '2025-03-04' AND book_date < DATE '2025-03-04' + INTERVAL '30 days' ), ticketed AS ( SELECT c.book_ref, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS tickets FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = c.book_ref GROUP BY c.book_ref ), segmented AS ( SELECT x.book_ref, x.tickets, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS boarded FROM ticketed x LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = x.book_ref LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id GROUP BY x.book_ref, x.tickets ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS bookings, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tickets > 0) AS with_tickets, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE segments > 0) AS with_segments, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE boarded > 0) AS with_boarding FROM segmented

WITH cohort AS ( SELECT book_ref FROM aviation.bookings WHERE book_date >= DATE '2025-03-04' AND book_date < DATE '2025-03-04' + INTERVAL '30 days' ), ticketed AS ( SELECT c.book_ref, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_no) AS tickets FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = c.book_ref GROUP BY c.book_ref ), segmented AS ( SELECT x.book_ref, x.tickets, COUNT(tf.flight_id) AS segments, COUNT(bp.ticket_no) AS boarded FROM ticketed x LEFT JOIN aviation.tickets t ON t.book_ref = x.book_ref LEFT JOIN aviation.ticket_flights tf ON tf.ticket_no = t.ticket_no LEFT JOIN aviation.boarding_passes bp ON bp.ticket_no = tf.ticket_no AND bp.flight_id = tf.flight_id GROUP BY x.book_ref, x.tickets ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS bookings, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tickets > 0) AS with_tickets, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE segments > 0) AS with_segments, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE boarded > 0) AS with_boarding FROM segmented

SELECT a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, COUNT(*) AS flights, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) AS avg_hours FROM aviation.aircrafts a JOIN aviation.flights f ON f.aircraft_code = a.aircraft_code GROUP BY a.aircraft_code, a.model, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport, a.range_km HAVING AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.scheduled_arrival - f.scheduled_departure)) / 3600) * 800 > a.range_km * 0.9 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC
